hook: mRNA vaccines primed rare HIV antibody-precursor B cells in monkeys after a single dose

readout.label: Affinity gain of N332-GT6 for precursor B cells

summary: Making broadly neutralizing HIV antibodies starts with activating very rare B cells. The team redesigned the immunogen to bind those cells 9-fold better, and delivered it as mRNA in lipid nanoparticles to macaques. The redesign primed the cells more consistently after one shot, and two booster shots pushed maturation. The work is in monkeys and shows early maturation only, not protection.
title: HIV broadly neutralizing antibody precursor maturation induced by mRNA vaccination in nonhuman primates
